migrations.description: Schedule: provider_account + calendar tables (ADR-507 Am1, ADR-314)
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provider_account (
  id                   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  provider_type        TEXT NOT NULL,
  external_account_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  email                TEXT,
  display_name         TEXT,
  connection_state     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'connected',
  created_at           INTEGER,
  updated_at           INTEGER,
  UNIQUE (provider_type, external_account_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calendar (
  id                   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_calendar_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  display_name         TEXT NOT NULL,
  color                TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_primary           INTEGER,
  read_only            INTEGER,
  selected             INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  added_at             INTEGER,
  created_at           INTEGER,
  updated_at           INTEGER,
  UNIQUE (account_id, provider_calendar_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_calendar_account  ON calendar(account_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_calendar_selected ON calendar(selected);

migrations.description: Schedule: event cache table + sync-bookkeeping cols on calendar (ADR-507 Am2, O495)
Schedule: calendar migration state cols + calendar_migration_run ledger (ADR-509)
Schedule: meeting_provider col on event table (A2 meeting-link detection)
migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE event ADD COLUMN meeting_provider TEXT;

queryTemplates.sql: SELECT id, provider_type, external_account_id, email, display_name, connection_state, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_account ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, provider_type, external_account_id, email, display_name, connection_state, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_account WHERE id = @id

SELECT id, provider_type, external_account_id, email, display_name, connection_state, created_at, updated_at FROM provider_account WHERE provider_type = @providerType AND external_account_id = @externalId

SELECT id, account_id, provider_calendar_id, display_name, color, is_primary, read_only, selected, added_at, created_at, updated_at, sync_token, last_synced_at, sync_status, sync_window_min, migration_status, last_migrated_at, last_synced_through FROM calendar ORDER BY added_at ASC

SELECT id, account_id, provider_calendar_id, display_name, color, is_primary, read_only, selected, added_at, created_at, updated_at, sync_token, last_synced_at, sync_status, sync_window_min, migration_status, last_migrated_at, last_synced_through FROM calendar WHERE id = @id

SELECT id, account_id, provider_calendar_id, display_name, color, is_primary, read_only, selected, added_at, created_at, updated_at, sync_token, last_synced_at, sync_status, sync_window_min, migration_status, last_migrated_at, last_synced_through FROM calendar WHERE selected = 1 ORDER BY added_at ASC

SELECT id, account_id, provider_calendar_id, display_name, color, is_primary, read_only, selected, added_at, created_at, updated_at, sync_token, last_synced_at, sync_status, sync_window_min, migration_status, last_migrated_at, last_synced_through FROM calendar WHERE account_id = @accountId ORDER BY added_at ASC

SELECT e.id, e.account_id, e.calendar_id, e.external_account_id, e.provider_calendar_id, e.provider_event_id, e.title, e.start, e.end, e.all_day, e.location, e.meeting_link, e.meeting_provider, e.organizer_email, e.organizer_name, e.organizer_self, e.attendees, e.status, e.updated_at, e.synced_at, c.color AS calendar_color, c.display_name AS calendar_display_name FROM event e JOIN calendar c ON c.id = e.calendar_id WHERE e.start >= @from AND e.start < @to ORDER BY e.start ASC

SELECT e.id, e.account_id, e.calendar_id, e.external_account_id, e.provider_calendar_id, e.provider_event_id, e.title, e.start, e.end, e.all_day, e.location, e.meeting_link, e.meeting_provider, e.organizer_email, e.organizer_name, e.organizer_self, e.attendees, e.status, e.updated_at, e.synced_at, c.color AS calendar_color, c.display_name AS calendar_display_name FROM event e JOIN calendar c ON c.id = e.calendar_id WHERE e.start >= @from AND e.start < @to AND c.selected = 1 ORDER BY e.start ASC
SELECT id, sync_token, last_synced_at, sync_status, sync_window_min FROM calendar WHERE id = @calendarId
SELECT id FROM event WHERE external_account_id = @externalAccountId AND provider_calendar_id = @providerCalendarId AND provider_event_id = @providerEventId
SELECT id FROM event WHERE calendar_id = @calendarId AND start < @cutoff

SELECT id, calendar_id, kind, started_at, completed_at, window_from, window_to, events_scanned, identities_found, status FROM calendar_migration_run WHERE calendar_id = @calendarId ORDER BY started_at DESC
